# The Biker Babies

> Adventure on Two Wheels!

The Biker Babies is an animated adventure series and book universe created by The Metavision Multimedia Limited. It follows a diverse crew of young riders on thrilling bike adventures, learning teamwork and friendship along the way.

## The Series

The Biker Babies animated series features 18 hero characters and 10 villains in action-packed bike adventures. Available on YouTube with companion books expanding the universe.

## The Biker Babies Crew (18 Heroes)

Amara (The Innovator), Zeya (The Tech Whiz), Kai (The Daredevil), Santiago (The Mechanic), Logan (The Navigator), Cassidy (The Artist), Arjun (The Strategist), Cinnamon (The Peacemaker), Harper (The Environmentalist), Ethan (The Entertainer), Hiro (The Inventor), Kofi (The Musician), Maddison (The Leader), Leilani (The Naturalist), Mateo (The Storyteller), Nia (The Scientist), Yara (The Athlete), Wyatt (The Historian)

## The Villains (10 Troublemakers)

Grumble Gnome, Grumpy Gearhead, Blaze, Sir Stop-Alot, Turbo Toad, Slick Sally, Count Crankshaft, The Flat Tyre Gang, Scorch, Grease Goblin
